title: Test Scaffolding
description: Generates the boilerplate for new tests - setup, teardown, assertion structure - from the code under test. Scaffolding removes the blank-page problem that keeps test coverage low.

title: Fixture Generation
description: Builds realistic test fixtures from schemas or production samples, anonymized where needed. Good fixtures make tests meaningful; hand-written toy data makes them lie.

title: Mock Synthesis
description: Synthesizes mocks for dependencies from their interfaces, with sensible default behaviors. Synthesized mocks let unit tests run without standing up the world.

title: Property-Based Tests
description: Generates thousands of random inputs checking declared properties - 'sorted output is ordered' - instead of hand-picked examples. Property tests find the edge cases humans never think of.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Fuzz Corpora
description: Builds and curates seed corpora for fuzzers from real inputs, maximizing coverage per fuzzing hour. Good corpora are the difference between fuzzing that finds bugs and fuzzing that burns CPU.

title: Coverage Targets
description: Sets per-module coverage targets enforced in CI, ratcheting upward over time. Targets make coverage a maintained property rather than a launch-day vanity metric.

title: Assertion Inference
description: Infers likely assertions from code behavior - 'this never returns null' - and proposes them as test assertions. Inference bootstraps meaningful assertions where developers would write only smoke tests.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Regression Capture
description: Turns every fixed bug into a permanent regression test automatically from the bug report's reproduction. Capture ensures fixed bugs stay fixed - the most valuable tests are the ones written by incidents.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Parallel Execution
description: Runs tests in parallel across workers with proper isolation, turning hour-long suites into minutes. Parallelism needs test independence - shared state is the enemy.

title: Flaky Detection
description: Detects flaky tests statistically - passing sometimes without code changes - and quarantines them automatically. Flaky detection protects the signal: a red build must mean broken code.

title: Test Data
description: Manages test datasets - versioned, documented, right-sized - so tests run against known data everywhere. Managed test data ends the 'works with my database' mysteries.

title: Contract Tests
description: Tests services against their API contracts - provider and consumer - catching breaking changes before integration. Contract tests let teams evolve independently with confidence.

title: Snapshot Tests
description: Captures output snapshots - rendered UI, API responses - and fails on unexpected changes, catching regressions humans overlook. Snapshots need deliberate review: every diff is a decision.
